verbs.name: captions.reflow
verbs.description: The FIX that satisfies verify.captions (measure->remedy loop, like normalize_loudness for the lufs check). Re-wraps over-length caption cues at word boundaries (<= max_chars) and extends too-fast cues into the following gap to lower reading speed (cps). Splitting cannot fix reading speed; extending into gaps can. Operates on canonical cap1 when present, otherwise the first caption-kind track (including captions.add_text's txt1); thresholds default to the verify.captions / timed-text standards and are overridable.

max_cps.description: Target max reading speed chars/sec (default 17); too-fast cues extend into gaps toward this.

max_chars.description: Max characters per cue before word-wrap split (default 84).

max_duration_ms.description: Cap on a cue's on-screen duration when extending (default 7000).

min_gap_ms.description: Gap preserved before the next cue when extending (default 80).

verbs.result: {track_id, cues_before, cues_after, extended, split, split_refused_short, still_too_fast}

verbs.name: captions.shift
verbs.description: Bulk-shift EVERY cue on canonical cap1 when present, otherwise the first caption-kind track (including captions.add_text's txt1), by offset_ms (negative = earlier) to correct a systematic sync offset — the standard subtitle delay/offset. Ranges clamp at 0 (never negative). Distinct from captions.set_range (one clip). Requires a generated, imported, or timed-text caption track.

offset_ms.description: Milliseconds to shift all cues; negative shifts earlier. Must be non-zero.

verbs.name: captions.set_range
verbs.description: Set a caption clip's absolute timeline range: retime (shift both edges) or trim (move one edge) for direct manipulation of caption clips. edit.move/edit.trim REFUSE caption clips (captions carry absolute ranges, not source ranges), so this is the only way to reposition a caption clip. The clip must be a caption clip; the range must be non-empty.

clip.description: Caption clip id (from project.state caption track clips)

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.name: captions.set_text
verbs.description: Replace an EXISTING caption clip's text (and optionally its style_ref) in place, by clip id — the edit companion to captions.set_range (retime). captions.add_text only ADDS a new caption; this EDITS one already on the timeline, so a placed caption is fully editable from the Inspector (select caption -> change words -> commit). The clip must be a caption clip; text must be non-empty.

clip.description: Caption clip id (from project.state caption track clips)

text.description: New caption text (non-empty; replaces the existing words)

style_ref.description: Optional: switch the caption to this caption_styles key (omit to keep the current style)

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {clip, old_text, text, style_ref}; one op appended
